questions.question: Neither of the boys _______ allowed to enter the science laboratory unsupervised.
questions.explanation: 不定代词 'Neither of + 复数名词' 作主语时，谓语动词通常用单数。句中表达一般事实，故选单数动词 'is'。

questions.question: Mrs Tan, together with her two daughters, _______ going to the supermarket this afternoon.
questions.explanation: 当主语后面跟有 'together with', 'as well as', 'accompanied by' 等介词短语时，谓语动词的单复数由主语核心词（Mrs Tan）决定，Mrs Tan 是单数，故用 'is'。

questions.question: We are all looking forward to _______ the National Museum next week.
questions.explanation: 'look forward to' 中的 'to' 是介词，后面必须接名词或动名词（V-ing），因此选 'visiting'。

questions.question: By the time Father arrived home last night, the children _______ their dinner.
questions.explanation: 'By the time + 一般过去时' 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经完成的动作，主句需要使用过去完成时（had + 过去分词），因此选 'had finished'。

questions.question: You rarely watch television on weekdays, _______ you?
questions.explanation: 反义疑问句遵循'前否后肯'原则。陈述部分含有否定副词 'rarely'（极少），视为否定句，附加疑问部分应使用肯定形式 'do you'。

questions.question: The boy _______ bicycle was stolen reported the incident to the police.
questions.explanation: 定语从句中修饰名词 'bicycle' 并表示所有关系（那个男孩的自行车），应用关系代词 'whose'。

questions.question: The new community library _______ by the Minister for Education yesterday.
questions.explanation: 主语 'The new community library' 是动作的承受者，且时间状语为 'yesterday'，应使用一般过去时的被动语态（was + 过去分词）。

questions.question: If it _______ tomorrow morning, our soccer match will be postponed.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句（真实条件句）中，遵循'主将从现'原则，if引导的条件状语从句用一般现在时表将来，主语 'it' 为第三人称单数，故用 'rains'。

questions.question: The teacher noticed a student _______ notes during the presentation.
questions.explanation: 感官动词 notice 的用法为 notice somebody doing something，表示注意到某人正在做某事，因此用动名词形式 'taking'。

questions.question: There is _______ water left in the kettle. We need to boil some more.
questions.explanation: water 是不可数名词，后句说明需要再烧一些，说明水'几乎没有'（表示否定），应用 'little'。

questions.question: A flock of birds _______ seen flying south earlier this morning.
questions.explanation: 集合名词短语 'A flock of birds' 作为一个整体单位看待，谓语动词用单数；时间为 'earlier this morning'，故用过去式 'was'。

questions.question: The doctor advised Uncle John to give up _______ greasy food.
questions.explanation: 短语动词 'give up'（放弃/戒掉）中的 up 为介词，后面接动词时须用动名词形式 'eating'。

questions.question: The number of endangered animals in this region _______ declining gradually.
questions.explanation: 'The number of...' 意为'……的数量'，中心词是 number，谓语动词用单数；而 'a number of' 意为'许多'，谓语动词用复数。故选 'is'。

questions.question: Let's clean up the classroom before going home, _______?
questions.explanation: 以 'Let's' 开头的祈使句，其反义疑问句固定用 'shall we?'；以 'Let us' 开头则通常用 'will you?'。

questions.question: The young pupils made all the origami decorations by _______.
questions.explanation: 'by oneself' 意为'独自/亲自'，主语是复数名词 'The young pupils'，对应的反身代词为 'themselves'。

questions.question: While Mei Ling _______ her homework, the lights suddenly went out.
questions.explanation: while 引导的时间状语从句表示过去某个持续进行的动作，主句是突发性动作（went out），从句应用过去进行时 'was doing'。

questions.question: If I _______ a bird, I would fly across the vast ocean.
questions.explanation: 第二条件句（与现在事实相反的虚拟语气），if 从句中的 be 动词在规范语法中一律用 'were'。

questions.question: The fierce fire was finally _______ by the brave firefighters after three hours.
questions.explanation: 考查动词短语辨析。put out 意为'扑灭'；put off 意为'推迟'；put on 意为'穿上'；put away 意为'收拾好'。扑灭大火用 'put out'。

questions.question: Neither Sarah nor her classmates _______ present at the seminar yesterday.
questions.explanation: 在 'neither...nor...' 结构中，谓语动词遵循'就近原则'。离谓语最近的主语是复数名词 'her classmates'，且事情发生在 'yesterday'，故用 'were'。

questions.question: David prefers cycling in the park _______ jogging around the track.
questions.explanation: 固定句型 'prefer doing A to doing B'，表示'比起做B，更喜欢做A'，介词用 'to'。

questions.question: Each of the participants _______ a medal upon completing the marathon.
questions.explanation: 'Each of + 复数名词' 作主语时，重心在 'Each'（每一个），谓语动词使用单数第三人称形式 'receives'。

questions.question: Ben said that he _______ his wallet on the school bus that morning.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句时态呼应。主句谓语是过去式 'said'，丢钱包的动作发生在'说'之前（过去的过去），应用过去完成时 'had lost'。

questions.question: The principal congratulated the choir members _______ their stellar performance.
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 'congratulate somebody on something'，意为'就某事向某人表示祝贺'，介词搭配为 'on'。

questions.question: _______ you submit the registration form by Friday, you will not be allowed to join the camp.
questions.explanation: 'Unless' 相当于 'if not'，意为'除非'。句意：除非你在周五前提交报名表，否则你将不能参加夏令营。

questions.question: _______ the heavy downpour, the soccer team carried on with their training.
questions.explanation: 'the heavy downpour' 是名词短语。Despite 是介词，后面接名词/短语；Although 和 Even though 是连词，后须接完整句子。

questions.question: The Tan family _______ in this neighbourhood since 2015.
questions.explanation: 句子含有 'since + 过去年份'，表示动作从过去持续到现在，应使用现在完成时（has/have + 过去分词），故选 'has lived'。

questions.question: Grandfather is used to _______ up at dawn to exercise in the garden.
questions.explanation: 'be used to doing something' 意为'习惯于做某事'，这里的 to 是介词，后接动名词形式 'waking'。注意区别于 'used to do'（过去常常做某事）。

questions.question: Everyone has submitted their project, _______?
questions.explanation: 在反义疑问句中，当陈述句主语是 everyone, everybody 等不定代词时，疑问部分代词通常用 they；前半句为肯定句，疑问部分用否定助动词 haven't。

questions.question: Mother reminded us to turn off the air conditioner so as _______ electricity.
questions.explanation: 固定短语 'so as to do something' 意为'为了/以便做某事'，接动词不定式原形，故选 'to save'。

questions.question: Hardly had the bell rung _______ the excited pupils dashed out of the classroom.
questions.explanation: 固定句式 'Hardly had + 主语 + 过去分词... when...' 意为'刚……就……'，hardly 与 when 搭配使用（而 No sooner 与 than 搭配）。
